documents.title: UMass Dartmouth Guidelines on the Use of Generative AI
documents.quality_note: Substantive guidelines (definitions, plagiarism standard, prohibitions, syllabus advice). Text is short (about 4.2k chars).

notes: Only copy found is hosted on newbedfordlight.org (a local news site), not umassd.edu; the document itself is the UMass Dartmouth guidelines. umass.edu/provost 'Responsible Use of Generative AI' was fetched but is the Amherst flagship, so discarded. No school or CIS-department AI policy found in searches.
